t: Before you is Holly Village, a Grade Two star listed estate of twelve Gothic cottages gathered around a private central garden. It's a fine example of the cottage orné style, and some people think of it as a village within a village. It was commissioned by Angela Burdett-Coutts, the philanthropist who inherited a fortune in 1837 and became one of the wealthiest women in England. The architect was Henry Darbishire, who worked on several projects for her and was later architect to the Peabody Trust.
